name: Example Mod C#

localizedSummaries.en-US: The tModLoader ExampleMod in C#, ported as the C# loaders arrive. For now: the Example Item, the Sword, the recipes, the Example armor with its set bonus, the Example robe, the Example life fruit and mana crystal, the Example immunity accessory, the Example buffs and buff potion, wings and shield, the Example damage class with its weapon and stat bonus accessory, the Example shotgun, minigun, sword and magic weapon.

summary: O ExampleMod do tModLoader em C#, portado conforme os loaders C# chegam. Por enquanto: o Exemplo de Item, a Espada, as receitas, a armadura com o bônus de conjunto, o manto, a fruta da vida e o cristal de mana, o acessório de imunidade, os buffs e a poção de buff de exemplo, as asas e o escudo, a classe de dano de exemplo, a escopeta, a metralhadora, a espada e a arma mágica de exemplo.
